## Import library

```{r}
library(here)
library(haven)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(foreach)
source(here("R", "read_nhanes.R"))
```

## merge cycles

```{r}
fetch <- read.csv(here("config", "sources.csv"), sep = ";")

df_all <- foreach(i = 1:nrow(fetch), .combine = bind_rows)%do%{
    row = fetch[i,]
    read_cycle(row)
}
saveRDS(df_all, here("data", "derived", "nhanes_merged.rds"))

```
